AVATAR_MAKER_CHANGES_REMAIN: Earlier painting saved; newer changes are not saved.
AVATAR_MAKER_SAVE_PENDING: Wait for the character skin save to finish.

AVATAR_MAKER_PNG_DOWNLOADED: PNG download started. Save a skin document to preserve layout information.
AVATAR_MAKER_SAVE_NOTICE: Save a skin document to keep your work.
AVATAR_MAKER_DISCARD: Discard the current painting? Save it first to keep it.
AVATAR_MAKER_OPEN_ERROR: Unable to open avatar model maker
